manager: Kimi intermediate MOA recursive self-report aggregator

assimilation_semantics.recursive_self_report_synthesis: After checkpoints 1 and 2, the MOA manager recursively revises one shared playbook using every current worker output admitted by the workflow self-report proxy. External Core and all-test scores are withheld. Every next-layer worker receives exactly that manager artifact.
assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Use the same model, workers, evolving public specifications, action budget, and checkpoint targets while suppressing all prior output.
assimilation_semantics.source_selection: No worker is selected or rejected using external evaluation. The treatment follows the existing recursive_self_report_synthesis policy.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and cleanly re-evaluate the same snapshot.

validity_gates.target_consistency: Every final layer result matches the frozen Core total and test hash for its checkpoint.
validity_gates.manager_activation: Treatment checkpoint-2 workers receive manager layer 1 and checkpoint-3 workers receive manager layer 2.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Manager layer 2 includes manager layer 1 plus the current self-report-admitted layer-2 outputs.
validity_gates.score_blinding: No manager request contains external Core, all-test, pass-count, or hidden-test outcomes.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: At least one treatment worker is admitted after each of layers 1 and 2.
validity_gates.control_headroom: No-transfer checkpoint-3 mean normalized all-test score is at least 0.50.
validity_gates.control_resource_validity: At least one of two no-transfer checkpoint-3 workers explicitly completes before action 40.
validity_gates.integrity: No final result has infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark access.

primary_estimand.name: Fixed-budget global-quality degradation
primary_estimand.metric: Mean normalized all-test score by checkpoint.
primary_estimand.resource_policy: All outcomes under the matched 40-action budget remain in the primary analysis. A treatment-induced increase in boundary exhaustion is part of the proposed complexity mechanism.
primary_estimand.completion_conditioned_secondary: Also report the checkpoint-3 gap among explicit completers.

degradation_criteria.sustained_negative_gaps: Treatment minus no-transfer all-test gaps are negative at checkpoints 2 and 3.
degradation_criteria.terminal_effect: Checkpoint-3 treatment mean all-test score is at least 0.10 below no transfer.
degradation_criteria.growing_divergence: The checkpoint-3 treatment-control gap is at least 0.05 more negative than the checkpoint-2 gap.
degradation_criteria.difference_in_differences: The treatment checkpoint-1-to-3 change minus the no-transfer checkpoint-1-to-3 change is at most -0.10.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Treatment checkpoint-3 mean input tokens are at least 15 percent above no transfer, or its checkpoint-3 action-boundary rate is higher.
degradation_criteria.all_required_for_target_curve: All validity gates and all five degradation criteria pass.

decision_rule.confirm_direction: If all target-curve requirements pass, freeze and run two additional independent replicates before making a paper claim.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If both checkpoint-2 and checkpoint-3 gaps are negative and terminal or difference-in-differences is negative but misses its magnitude threshold, run one identical replicate.
decision_rule.falsify_pair: If validity passes but either checkpoint-2 or checkpoint-3 treatment-control gap is non-negative, stop the Kimi cfgpipe sequential pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Repair only documented infrastructure failures or target drift; do not reinterpret model or action-budget failures as infrastructure.

infrastructure_amendment.failure: Concurrent PyPI TLS failures produced zero-test native evaluations and exhausted all three clean-evaluation retries before any treatment feedback layer was formed.
infrastructure_amendment.repair: Enable the already frozen 20-wheel local SCBench wheelhouse for cfgpipe, including the exact deepdiff and rpds-py artifacts that failed to download.
